info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Human Resource Management By Recruitment Id-spec
info.description: The Human Resource Management Update API enables organizations to efficiently modify recruitment details using a specific recruitment ID. This endpoint supports updates to human resource management information, allowing businesses to keep their recruitment records current and accurate. Typical consumers include HR personnel and recruitment managers who need to make adjustments based on candidate feedback or changes in recruitment status. By integrating this API, companies can enhance their recruitment workflows and ensure better tracking of human resource activities.
